Denis Jovitus Buberwa is a multipurpose ICT professional based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. He is:

- A **software developer** whose primary stack is MERN (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js), with
  additional proficiency in TypeScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, Ktor, C#, and PHP.
- An **ICT systems administrator**, currently ICT Officer at ATCL SACCOS, administering Windows/Linux
  servers, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Cloudflare DNS, and firewalls (UFW).
- A **cybersecurity enthusiast** exploring ethical hacking and network security.
- A **blockchain explorer**, learning and experimenting with blockchain technology.
- An **AI agents professional**, focused on AI agent systems and automation.
